items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Louie put him in that business... Crouch gave them a check... he used to send his kid... to talk to Louie... Crouch used to go to Mexico and get this tea for him

ctx.x: So he came over there at Billy Berg's, after the place opened up. He invited the group over to the place for some drinks and a little snack if they wanted. Now, Louie put him in that business, now. And by a quirk, I didn't go, I didn't feel like going. It was something -- I didn't go. And the guys that went, Earl Hines and [Jack Teagarden] all the rest of them, went over there. And when they were getting ready to leave, Crouch gave them a check. And that burned Louie up. And he used to send his kid, like, go to…
Yeah, well, he was the godfather to one of his daughters, --
